descriptions: Fixed saved outfits never reaching the database in a priced shop because the payment gate rejected the save that the client had deliberately made free
Fixed the wardrobe applying an outfit only on the local ped, so it was lost on the next reconnect
Fixed the wardrobe being impossible to reopen after closing it with the X button, which also left the menu session and camera loop running
Free outfit saves are now rebuilt server-side from the stored appearance plus the owned outfit, so unpaid hair, face and tattoo edits are dropped
